entities.summary: Ottoman Empire, a political institution in Bulgaria during National Revival & Liberation (1878–1900). Grew from Liberation of Bulgaria — Russo-Turkish War and April Uprising (1876) and Ottoman atrocities. Led to the emergence of Principality of Bulgaria & Unification.
